text:
olga: quick loop on a pattern we saw in pool-E: very hot 64/128B scratch buffers interleaved with medium pinned tensors leading to neighbor thrash.

harry: similar to earlier notes but different root: the allocator spreads small slots across a slab stripe which increases adjacency with pinned mids.

mina: idea: segregated 'hot stripe' pools for tiny scratch to keep high-churn slots isolated. combined with an allocation stripe policy so small objects are allocated from dedicated lanes.

ryan: benefits: reduces cross-size adjacency, makes recluster/coalesce simpler because slabs become homogeneous. Downsides: potential underutilization if hot lanes idle.

olga: countermeasure: adaptive lane sizing. Monitor lane_util and lane_frag; if a lane is cold for T_idle, merge lanes back into general pool.

harry: implementation: introduce allocator.mode = STRIPED | MIXED, and per-lane bitmap + hotness_counter (4-bit saturating). On alloc path choose lane with lowest recent_allocs for fairness.

mina: to avoid scan cost, maintain small per-lane reservoir sampler and a cheap bloom for hotness to decide which slots to pin to hot lanes. When bloom hits consistently move slab to hot lane group.

ryan: worker work: recluster should treat stripe-homogeneous slabs differently: if slab is hot-lane and utilization < 40%, try lane-shrink instead of global coalesce. Also fast-path gossip to neighbor lanes to steal underutilized slabs.

olga: telemetry we want: lane_count, lane_util_pct, moved_slabs, lane_evictions, lane_merge_ops, hot_bloom_falsepos_pct. Add trace events when slab moves lane.

harry: perf thought: simulate on replay harness. I expect reduced PCIe bounce and fewer small-copy evictions. But watch for host_rss increase from reserved lanes.

telemetry-bot: replay job queued: striped-lane-sim #9902. Results in ~90m.

mina: rollout: feature-flag STRIPED per-pool. Default off for enterprise pools. Canary 3% nodes with lane_reserve=4MB. If host_rss delta < 150MB and offload_bytes saved > 20% expand.

ryan: edge: NUMA-aware placement. Hot lanes should prefer local NUMA nodes to preserve kernel locality for AVX work. Add per-lane numa_hint.

olga: also need correctness: moves must preserve slot addresses and not race with free/alloc. Use slab-move lock and CAS update of slot metadata; workers retry on CAS failures.

harry: can someone draft a brief RFC with pseudocode for lane allocation, bloom hysteresis, and lane-shrink policy? Include sim numbers from replay.

mina: I'll write it and attach the sim when perf finishes. Thanks.
